I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I noted the correction: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats. As he asked, I didn't change anything.

I also suggested he post the correction in #central-team, since his earlier message there still shows the wrong number. A seat count is an account fact, not a money term, so no approval was needed.
